parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the switch part of the object, made of durable plastic. It is a small cylindrical component protruding from the base body.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the actuator that toggles the electrical circuit on or off when pressed or flipped.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly or rotationally depending on the switch type, allowing user input to control the circuit.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the switch, made of plastic, providing structural support for the switch mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the switch in place and houses the internal electrical connections.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides a stable mounting surface for the switch.
